C'est un bail de location meublée de 1 à: It is a French furnished lease of 1 to 10 months, created by the ELAN law of 23 November 2018 (articles 25-12 et suivants de la loi du 6 juillet 1989). It can be neither renewed nor extended by tacit agreement, and the landlord may not ask for a security deposit.
Qui peut louer en bail mobilité à Nice ?: Who can rent under a bail mobilité in Nice?
Une personne en formation professionnell: A person in professional training, higher education, an apprenticeship, an internship, civic service (service civique), a work relocation or a temporary assignment. Proof of the reason is requested before the lease is signed.
Mon employeur peut-il payer le loyer ?: Can my employer pay the rent?
Oui. Quand une société, une agence de re: Yes. When a company, a relocation agency, an insurer or a production company pays, the apartment is let under a lease in the organisation's name, from 3 months, with an invoice in its name. No proof of reason is then required.
Tout : charges, électricité, eau, climat: Everything: service charges, electricity, water, air conditioning, fibre internet, private parking space, pool access, bed and bath linen, welcome kit and final cleaning. The tenant receives no energy bills.
2 880 € par mois pour 7 à 10 mois, 3 200: €2,880 per month for 7 to 10 months, €3,200 per month for 3 to 6 months and €3,600 per month for 1 to 2 months, all inclusive.
Visale n'est pas mobilisable à ce niveau: Visale, the French state rent guarantee, is not available at this rent level. The guarantee takes the form of a guarantor: your employer or a private individual.
Peut-on louer moins d'un mois ?: Can I rent for less than a month?
No. The minimum stay is one month.
Le jour de votre entrée, nous vous accue: On your move-in day, we welcome you on site. We hand over the keys and draw up the check-in inventory and the furniture list together with you. The time is agreed with you, according to your arrival.
